icon_cast_independent_check.note: AvatarIconBaker reported cast_px=0 for all four, but an independent re-measurement on the shipped PNGs with the same rule used for the portraits (R>G+8 AND B>G+8, any alpha>=1) finds the counts below. Correcting the earlier 'all zero' claim.
icon_cast_independent_check.rule: R>G+8 AND B>G+8 on any pixel with alpha>=1
icon_cast_independent_check.assessment: not visible purple fringing. All flagged pixels are near-black ink: max channel value 15-116 out of 255. d002/d003 flag at <=9% HSV saturation (imperceptible). d000's single 60%-saturation pixel is (15,6,15) - 6% brightness, invisible on screen. For contrast, the magenta removed from the portraits covered thousands of pixels at mid/high brightness. The de-fringe pass is not re-run on icons because the baker composites them at 256px directly from the already-neutralised portraits.
